_readme: Curated control ownership, one row per franchise, keyed to (team, league) on the Team Valuations board. Hand-edited: this file IS the source of truth. Run scripts/build-team-owners-data.py to rebuild public/data/owners/team-owners.json. owner_key is the rollup key - exactly one control entity per franchise so portfolio totals cannot double count. owner_type follows UEFA taxonomy (European Club Finance and Investment Landscape 2025, p.67). confidence: sourced = primary source read; cross-checked = aggregator value confirmed against a 2024-2026 control-change sweep; contested = control unresolved or sale pending.

rows.note: Levy left as executive chairman in Sep 2025 and his family trusts sold 24.99% of ENIC in Jun 2026. Control is unchanged.

rows.note: CONTROL UNRESOLVED. Sullivan stepped down as chairman in Jun 2026. Around 1 Aug 2026 the Gold family agreed to sell its 25.1% to an Amanda Staveley-led consortium; Staveley then bid for Sullivan's entire holding. A two-month pre-emption process was running when this data was compiled.

RedBird's involvement is minority and does not join Alpine to the AC Milan portfolio.

rows.minority: Arctos Partners; HPS Investment Partners and Accel; Saudi Arabia's PIF, about 8%; Adrian Newey
rows.note: Control has sat with Stroll's consortium since it rescued Force India in 2018. Aston Martin Lagonda, the carmaker, agreed in Jul 2025 to sell its own equity in the team for about £110m at a valuation near £2.4bn while keeping the naming rights, so the team and the car company are no longer the same asset. PIF's stake here is minority and does not join it to Newcastle's portfolio.

rows.stake_label: Largest shareholder: 21.2% of capital, 32.2% of votes

rows.note: Scuderia Ferrari is not separately owned: it sits inside listed Ferrari N.V. EXOR is not a majority holder, but its loyalty-share voting bloc with the Ferrari family trust is decisive, and the two extended their shareholders' agreement on 3 Jan 2026 to 2029. Same control entity as Juventus, which is why the two now share a portfolio here.

Sole ownership since the team's 2016 entry. The Toyota Gazoo Racing arrangement signed in Oct 2024 and upgraded to title sponsorship for 2026 is commercial and carries no equity. Takeover approaches have been rejected.

Audi completed its full acquisition of Sauber Holding in Jan 2025, then sold a substantial minority to the Qatar Investment Authority. The Kick Sauber name covers 2024 and 2025; the same entry runs as the Audi works team from 2026, which is why Sportico's 2026 list and this row still carry the Sauber name.

rows.minority: CYVN Holdings LLC (Abu Dhabi), about 19%, expressly non-controlling
rows.note: McLaren Racing and McLaren Automotive now have different owners. CYVN bought the car business in Apr 2025 plus a non-controlling stake in the race team; the team stayed with Bahrain's sovereign fund. On 2 Sep 2025 the group bought out the remaining racing minorities, including MSP Sports Capital and Ares funds, at a valuation near $5bn.

rows.owner_display: Mercedes-Benz Group, INEOS and Toto Wolff
rows.co_controllers: Mercedes-Benz Group AG 33.3%; INEOS (Jim Ratcliffe) 33.3%; Toto Wolff 28.3%
rows.note: Deliberately recorded as having no single controller. INEOS bought in as an equal third in Dec 2020 and the three have held roughly even stakes since; Wolff sold a slice of his holding to George Kurtz in Nov 2025 at a valuation near $6bn without changing the balance. Picking the largest of three near-equal partners would assert a control that does not exist.

Red Bull's second entry, wholly owned. The Toro Rosso to AlphaTauri to RB to Racing Bulls sequence was branding, not ownership; the entrant at Faenza has been the same company since 2006. Reported approaches for the team have been rejected.

Wholly owned by Red Bull GmbH, itself 51% Yoovidhya family and 49% Mark Mateschitz. Christian Horner's departure in 2025 involved no equity. Red Bull's fourth club on this board, alongside Racing Bulls, RB Leipzig and the New York Red Bulls.

Unchanged since Dorilton bought the team from the Williams family in Aug 2020 for about $200m. Dorilton is evergreen-funded rather than a closed-end fund, so there is no exit clock of the kind that usually drives a private-equity sale.

rows.minority: Elliott Management has held creditor and minority positions
rows.note: Merlyn Partners bought the club from Gerard Lopez in Dec 2020 through a Luxembourg chain and installed Olivier Letang as president. A 2022 reorganisation followed the debt restructuring without moving ultimate control. Graded cross-checked rather than sourced because the cap table is not publicly disclosed and the only primary record is the 2020 acquisition.

Completed 26 Jun 2026, ending John Textor's ownership after Eagle Bidco entered UK administration in Mar 2026. Kang also owns the Washington Spirit and London City Lionesses through Kynisca Sports International.

Owned since the 2016 purchase from Margarita Louis-Dreyfus, held through a Delaware chain into SASP Olympique de Marseille. McCourt told supporter groups in Feb 2026 that the club is not for sale; reports of a price at which he would listen are not a process, and nothing is signed.
QSI is a subsidiary of the Qatar Investment Authority and also holds a stake in SC Braga.

rows.owner_display: FC Bayern Munchen e.V. (members' club, 400,000+ members)
rows.note: 50+1 is satisfied by the e.V.'s 75%. Volkswagen was reported in Jul 2026 to be considering selling Audi's 8.33%, which would not change control.

rows.owner_display: Ballspielverein Borussia 09 e.V. Dortmund, via the general partner
rows.stake_label: e.V. holds 5.45% of shares but controls the general partner
rows.minority: Bernd Geske (8.30%), Evonik (8.20%), Signal Iduna (5.98%), Puma (5.32%), Dommermuth (5.03%), free float 61.72%
rows.note: Do not read the 5.45% as an absence of control. The KGaA structure gives the e.V.-owned general partner management control, which is exactly how BVB complies with 50+1 while being publicly traded on XETRA.

rows.minority: Freunde des Adlers, Freunde der Eintracht Frankfurt AG, Herzschlag Eintracht, Gude Eintracht GmbH
rows.note: The e.V. remains majority shareholder and 50+1 is intact, but the club has not published the split after the May 2025 capital increase, so the exact current percentage is unconfirmed.

RasenBallsport Leipzig e.V. formally satisfies 50+1, but the voting membership is deliberately minimal and Red Bull-approved. Red Bull also owns the New York Red Bulls, RB Salzburg, Bragantino and RB Omiya Ardija, with minority stakes in Leeds United and Paris FC.
A Jan-Feb 2026 refinancing removed the Elliott-linked vendor loan, ending Elliott's residual financial hold. RedBird also owns Toulouse FC and holds stakes in Fenway Sports Group and the YES Network.
Acquired Aug 2020 and consolidated via a mandatory tender offer. The Friedkin Group also owns Everton.

Listed on Borsa Italiana. Lotito publicly denied sale negotiations in Oct 2025.

SALE PENDING. Walter's own purchase closed 30 Oct 2025 at roughly $10B after a unanimous NBA vote. On 12 Aug 2026, fourteen months later, he agreed to sell the controlling stake to Josh Kushner and Bob Iger at a reported $12.5B, a record for a US sports franchise. The Dodgers and the Sparks are not part of that deal. Jeanie Buss remains team Governor and the buyers have said they intend to honour the pact that keeps her there, so the split between economic control and league governance survives the change. The NBA Board of Governors had not voted when this data was compiled.

rows.owner_display: Ryan and Ashley Smith (Smith Entertainment Group)
rows.note: The NHL approved the $1.2B transfer of the Arizona Coyotes' hockey operation to Smith Entertainment Group on 18 Apr 2024; the club was named the Utah Mammoth on 7 May 2025. Alex Meruelo holds no stake. SEG also owns the Utah Jazz.
Foley consolidated control in Jan 2024 by buying out the Maloof brothers. Foley also owns AFC Bournemouth through Black Knight Football Club.

rows.note: Completed Sep 2024 at a $250m enterprise value, then a record for a women's professional team, with Willow Bay as the designated controlling owner. A hybrid: publicly listed on Euronext Amsterdam but majority-controlled by the members' association.

rows.minority: Vrienden van Feyenoord, roughly 46-49%; Stichting Supporters steunen Feyenoord, about 1%
rows.note: The foundation holds the majority of Feyenoord Rotterdam N.V. plus a golden share, giving it the right to appoint directors and to veto changes to the name, crest, colours, academy and home ground. The minority sits with the supporters' group that recapitalised the club in 2010 and is being bought back in tranches.

rows.co_controllers: Eindhovense Voetbalvereniging PSV holds a golden share
rows.note: Neither investor-owned nor directly member-owned. Professional football sits in PSV N.V., whose majority shareholder is a foundation; the 1913 members' association keeps a golden share protecting name, crest and governance. The 2016 partner-fund injection from Philips, ASML, VDL and others was financing, not equity, and moved no ownership.

rows.note: Villas-Boas ended Pinto da Costa's 42-year presidency in Apr 2024 and has publicly ruled out selling SAD equity to outside investors. The SAD had roughly EUR 175m of negative equity at 31 Dec 2024.

Each socio holds one non-tradeable, non-monetary share. Sixth Street and Legends hold 30% of the Bernabeu stadium operations business, which is a venue joint venture, not club equity.

rows.owner_display: No controlling shareholder; board led by Jokin Aperribay
rows.stake_label: Dispersed, with a statutory cap near 2%
rows.note: Filed here as member-owned in spirit, but the precise form matters: Real Sociedad is a Sociedad Anonima Deportiva, not a socios' association like Barcelona or Athletic. No shareholder may exceed roughly 2% of capital, so control is exercised collectively through the elected board. Socios and shareholders are different populations at this club, and the shareholder count is not published.

The Sergio Ramos / Five Eleven Capital deal collapsed in May 2026; an unnamed Western fund signed a new letter of intent in Jun 2026 targeting early Aug 2026, which could not be confirmed as closed. The 777 Partners stake is caught in the 777/A-CAP insolvency.

Turkey's first club on this board.

Bought control in Jun 2021 for about $400m and bought out the remaining minority partners in Aug 2022. The group also owns the NWSL Houston Dash.
The Mas brothers and Beckham bought out Marcelo Claure and Masayoshi Son in Sep 2021, funded by a $150m Ares preferred-equity investment. Jorge Mas is Managing Owner and CEO.
Joe Tsai sold his stake at a ~$1.25B valuation in Mar 2026 and Carlos Vela joined as an owner. Larry Berg, previously co-managing owner, was named MLS Commissioner on 3 Aug 2026 and must divest.
AEG also owns the LA Kings, the Ontario Reign, Eisbaren Berlin and about 23.5% of Hammarby IF. The 2012 sale process was abandoned in Mar 2013.

Founding investor-operator since MLS launched in 1996, held through the same family company as the New England Patriots. The live project is a soccer-specific stadium in Everett rather than anything to do with control.
Claure bought 10% at a ~$1.5B valuation on 17 Sep 2024. CFG itself is 81% Abu Dhabi United Group, 18% Silver Lake. Yankee Global is the Steinbrenner family vehicle that owns the New York Yankees.

Owner since 9 Mar 2006. Red Bull GmbH is 51% the Chalerm Yoovidhya family and 49% Mark Mateschitz. The group also holds RB Leipzig, RB Salzburg, Bragantino, RB Omiya Ardija, and minority stakes in Leeds United and Paris FC.

No control change 2024-26. The Timbers were NOT part of the Trail Blazers sale: the Blazers came from the Paul G. Allen estate. Paulson sold NWSL's Portland Thorns to RAJ Sports in Jan 2024.

rows.owner_display: Miller Sports + Entertainment (Larry H. Miller family)

RSL and the Utah Royals were sold for about $600m in Apr 2025 by David Blitzer and Ryan Smith's Smith Entertainment Group to the Miller family, who had themselves sold the Jazz to Smith in 2020. The two Utah portfolios swapped rather than merged.

Note the nuance that the Illigs retain the governor and alternate-governor seats. Mallouk also holds a minority stake in the Kansas City Royals.
The Taylor family owns Enterprise Mobility. The first majority female-owned MLS club. Kindle separately joined the St. Louis Blues ownership group.

rows.owner_display: Greg Kerfoot-led group (Kerfoot, Steve Luczo, Jeff Mallett, Steve Nash)
rows.note: SALE PROCESS LIVE, NOTHING SIGNED. The owners put the club up for sale in Dec 2024, partly for estate-planning reasons, with Goldman Sachs engaged. The only public offer to emerge, disclosed around 1 May 2026, comes from a group led by Grant Gustavson and proposes relocating the club to Las Vegas. MLS has approved nothing and Canadian officials are pressing to keep the team. Recorded here under the current owners because they still hold control.

Expansion franchise awarded to the Golden State Warriors ownership group in Oct 2023 for a $50m fee, first played in 2025. Shares Chase Center and the Warriors' back office, and is the most valuable club in the league at its first time of asking.

Davis bought the Aces from MGM Resorts, approved unanimously by the WNBA and NBA Boards of Governors in Feb 2021. Same control person as the Las Vegas Raiders, which makes Las Vegas one of the few metros where one owner holds two codes.

rows.note: Walter's group has held the Sparks since 2014, long before the Dodgers-adjacent purchases that made the name familiar. The Sparks are explicitly NOT part of the Lakers sale agreed on 12 Aug 2026, so this row stays with Walter while the Lakers row sits on the watchlist.

The Lynx were part of the Timberwolves package, not a separate deal. The NBA Board of Governors approved the $1.5bn sale unanimously in Jun 2025 after Glen Taylor declined to appeal the arbitration ruling, and the buyers took the whole thing rather than the 80% originally planned. Rodriguez is Lynx governor.

rows.owner_display: Joe Tsai and Clara Wu Tsai (BSE Global)

The couple announced a divorce in Jul 2026 and stated it would not affect ownership of either franchise.
Acquired with the Phoenix Suns in the same transaction, approved by the NBA Board of Governors in Feb 2023 after Robert Sarver was forced to sell.

rows.minority: Sue Bird, joined 2024; Bobby Wagner, joined Jul 2025
rows.note: One of the few clubs on this board with no men's-league parent. The same three principals have held control since buying the team out of Clay Bennett's hands in Jan 2008 for $10m, which against a 2026 valuation of $425m is the best return on this board.
